mostWorthwhile.text: The failed clinic lookup and its repair were most worthwhile: they exposed a hidden corporate-directory dependency and made the local replacement concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: The call-test attempt was slightly confusing: I chose the radio link, but the handset needed the rack instead, and the game performed that operation automatically.

surprise.text: The radios could exchange packets while the handset still could not find the clinic because its directory was external.

arbitrary.text: The exact partner for the call test was not obvious to me, although the automatic correction explained how the local directory was used.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how the neighborhood's preparations hold up during migration; discovering and fixing the hidden dependency made the rehearsal engaging.
